A17.title: Actual synchronous Engine integration validation
A17.boundary_and_ownership: Real synchronous Engine conformance using miniz_oxide codec category, not a byte-sum mock.
A17.native_reuse: miniz_oxide native zlib compression and bounded decompression; .NET ZLibStream is compatibility/cost oracle.
A17.csharp_surface: Typed codec span/array/owned-buffer facade with explicit size limit.
implementation_steps: Wrap real pinned native algorithm in minimal C exports and explicit owner release; opt out of executor/callback capabilities.
Use fallible checked admission and bounded decompressor; state honest OOM/unwind limits and partial-output drop behavior.
Consume through generated facade and independent NuGet ordinary/AOT application.
Record incremental Engine code/dependency/package costs and compare direct Rust behavior without numerical superiority claims.

Keep codec raw-input, compressed-input and decompressed-output limits separate. A successful compression must be admissible by this same profile decoder: reserve a source-justified worst output/peak bound or fail compression before owner publication when the encoded result would exceed its input cap. Never copy the finite fixture same-4MiB-input assumption into a product round-trip guarantee.
error_cancellation_resources_concurrency: Malformed or oversized/decompression-bomb inputs expose no partial owner; empty input handled explicitly.
Synchronous algorithm does not advertise cancellation after the noninterruptible native call starts.
specific_acceptance: Direct Rust versus C# versus ZLibStream round-trip for varied sizes, malformed input and limit; creating allocator frees exactly once.
Windows/Linux AOT and no global Tokio startup; independent app change preserves native hash.

Inject a deterministic managed-wrapper construction exception after native success returns a non-null owned result but before managed ownership commits; assert exactly-once release of the raw native owner, no partial result, leak or double free. A successful wrapper uses the single SafeHandle release path. Execute both cases on Windows/Linux normal and Native AOT consumers.

At each declared codec limit test incompressible boundary data and encoded expansion: either successful compress/decompress round-trips under the same profile or compression returns the documented limit error without publishing an unusable owner. Include decoded-output overrun and truncated/corrupt input with exact retirement.
A17.dependency_rationale: start pins only actually consumed completed modules; acceptance adds local assembled-runtime checks where required. Reference links alone never become a global barrier.
